task: Generate five meme-image candidates for the same non-serious technical blog passage in five independent runs.
target: The repeated runs should explore meaningfully different visual grammars without collapsing quality.

task: Generate five candidates for a reject-vs-prefer shaped passage where Drake is an obvious answer.
target: At least three sampled candidates receive genuine attempts; the batch is not five variants of Drake-like grammar.

task: Use a passage whose joke depends on a project-specific screenshot or scene and compare stock template, custom background, self-hosted render, and original-visual routes when available.
target: The evaluator can identify when the missing diversity is a generation-route problem rather than a template-ID problem.

task: Given recent-use evidence containing three templates, generate a five-candidate exploration batch for a new post.
target: Recent templates are avoided unless one wins on a clearly documented editorial-fit exception.

task: Inspect the evidence record for an exploration batch.
target: A reviewer can distinguish actual random draws from model-selected candidates and can see why any sampled template was rejected.
